question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        bb.striker AS player_id,
        bb.team_batting,
        SUM(b.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored b
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON b.match_id = bb.match_id AND b.over_id = bb.over_id AND b.ball_id = bb.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.match_id, bb.striker, bb.team_batting
    HAVING SUM(b.runs_scored) >= 100
) player_scores
JOIN player p ON player_scores.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN match m ON player_scores.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player_match pm ON player_scores.match_id = pm.match_id AND player_scores.player_id = pm.player_id
WHERE player_scores.team_batting = pm.team_id
  AND player_scores.team_batting != m.match_winner
ORDER BY p.player_name
